page.overview:
Who is Arno?

Arno was approached by the Prisoner in Pinnacle Station, where he offered to train them as a swordmaster, boasting of his knowledge of the teachings of Jool Noret. He also told them of Harko Village, warning them that it was infested with misfits such as the Sandflies and the Maas Kharet.
